- **What I did:** Nesh-Deeka sent me to Helstrom by coast ship. I told Ei-Tuja that the Hist at Low-Reed Village was cut at the root, not silent. He will preach that in every village he walks to.

- **Loose ends:** The wasps Nesh-Deeka warned about never appeared. I never talked to Kaska-Meen.
- **Bug:** Nesh-Deeka's reply showed a "[not yet written; the gist:]" placeholder instead of finished dialogue.

I gave my full take through the end command.
